impactScope.description: How includeImpact scopes the impact block. property (default) keeps the note's own scope. per_url (requires url — an error without it, even without includeImpact) computes the impact for the url filter only and reports impact_scope=per_url with impact.urls_used set to the matched stored URL(s); with urlMatch=exact it also lists the pattern notes whose conditions cover the URL (decided by the note's own impact SQL; a prefix/contains fragment is not a page, so it lists none), with or without includeImpact.

includeImpact.description: Attach the before/after GSC impact block (7/14/30-day windows) to each annotation. Caps the page to 10 rows (50 when url is set) and costs 3 credits per annotation. Default false.

keyword.description: Keep only the annotations explicitly scoped to this GSC query (a List of Keywords containing it); all-keyword notes are excluded. Exact match after trimming, collapsing whitespace and lowercasing — no substring or pattern matching. Combines with url (a note must match both). One keyword per call.

range.description: Date-range preset. Mutually exclusive with from/to; omit range, from and to for last_3_months.

url.description: Keep only the annotations attached to this URL — notes that name it literally (single-URL, list-of-URLs, or an exactly-matches/list-of-urls condition of a multi-condition note); sitewide notes and pattern conditions are excluded (impactScope=per_url with urlMatch=exact adds the pattern notes covering the URL). Normalized on both sides — scheme, www, trailing slash, case and utm params never decide a match. One URL per call.

urlMatch.description: How url is compared: exact (default), prefix (plain string prefix — .../blog also matches .../blog-old) or contains (substring; accepts a bare fragment like blog/post-1). Ignored without url.
